# imgix_source (Resource)

Manages an Imgix source (GCS origin) through the Imgix Management API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "imgix_source" "media" {
  name = "example.com media (production)"

  deployment = {
    type             = "gcs"
    imgix_subdomains = ["example-media"]
    gcs_bucket       = "media.example.com"
    gcs_access_key   = var.gcs_hmac_access_key
    gcs_secret_key   = var.gcs_hmac_secret_key

    default_params = { auto = "compress,format" }

    cache_ttl_behavior = "respect_origin"
    cache_ttl_value    = 31536000
    image_missing      = "https://example.com/assets/missing.png"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `deployment` (Attributes) Origin and serving configuration. Only GCS origins (type = "gcs") are supported. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--deployment))
- `name` (String) Display name of the source. Distinct from the delivery hostname.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the source serves traffic. Omitted preserves the remote value.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))
- `wait_for_deployed` (Boolean) Poll after deployment-triggering writes until the source reaches its intended terminal state.

### Read-Only

- `date_deployed` (Number) Unix timestamp of the last completed deployment.
- `deployment_status` (String) API deployment status: deploying, deployed, disabled, or deleted.
- `domains` (Set of String) Full delivery hostnames: imgix subdomains plus custom domains. No scheme.
- `id` (String) Imgix source ID.
- `secure_url_token` (String, Sensitive) Signing token for secured sources. Only present when secure_url_enabled is true.

<a id="nestedatt--deployment"></a>
### Nested Schema for `deployment`

Required:

- `gcs_bucket` (String) GCS bucket name, without a gs:// prefix.
- `imgix_subdomains` (Set of String) Bare *.imgix.net subdomains (e.g. "example-media"). At least one; unique across all sources.
- `type` (String) Origin type. Only "gcs" is supported by this release.

Optional:

- `annotation` (String) Comment recorded on the deployment. Empty string clears.
- `cache_ttl_behavior` (String) How the TTL on served images is determined.
- `cache_ttl_error` (Number) TTL in seconds for error images when the origin cannot be fetched (1-31536000).
- `cache_ttl_value` (Number) TTL in seconds used by cache_ttl_behavior (1800-31536000).
- `crossdomain_xml_enabled` (Boolean) Serve a cross-domain policy file when requested.
- `custom_domains` (Set of String) Full DNS hostnames Imgix terminates. Explicit [] clears.
- `default_params` (Map of String) Imgix render parameters applied to all requests, e.g. { auto = "compress,format" }. Explicit {} clears.
- `gcs_access_key` (String, Sensitive) GCS HMAC access key. Required on create; preserved from state afterwards.
- `gcs_prefix` (String) Folder prefix prepended to image paths before resolving in GCS. Empty string clears.
- `gcs_secret_key` (String, Sensitive) GCS HMAC secret. Required on create; the API never returns it, so the known value is preserved in state.
- `image_error` (String) Absolute URL served when a request errors. Empty string clears.
- `image_error_append_qs` (Boolean) Forward the failed request's query parameters to image_error.
- `image_missing` (String) Absolute URL served when the origin image is missing. Empty string clears.
- `image_missing_append_qs` (Boolean) Forward the failed request's query parameters to image_missing.
- `secure_url_enabled` (Boolean) Require requests to be signed with secure_url_token. Never enabled implicitly on an existing source.

Read-Only:

- `allows_upload` (Boolean) Whether Imgix can upload to the origin. Absent from the API means unknown, not false.


<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
#!/bin/sh
# Import an existing source by its 24-character ID (visible in the dashboard URL).
terraform import imgix_source.media 6583999a6e489be528f1729a
```
